resources.string: Five different layers stay separate. Open Decisions anytime to inspect proposals, evidence and history.
Original text, owned by you. Only your deliberate edits change this file; analysis and knowledge review do not rewrite it.
A local parser proposes what the source might mean. It can be incomplete, ambiguous or wrong. It is not automatically a fact.
You may write or approve an explicit claim or hypothesis. This is an entry in the separate journal, with provenance and history, not a change to the note.
A fact is deliberately marked as confirmed by you. This label records your assessment; it does not prove objective truth.
A link, similarity or inferred conclusion is a separate, potentially uncertain result. Possible conflicts and lexical backlinks need inspection.
Offline by default. Cloud LLMs are optional. Confirmation modifies the journal only after your approval. Journal export is not a full backup of your notes.
Interpretations are proposals. Only a human decision can change the separate knowledge journal; original Markdown stays untouched.

Compare exact parsed entity symbols with two original source excerpts. Only your explicit approval records an alias; revocation is an additional journal event, not deletion. Neither action merges notes or proves identity.
Enter two different exact symbols seen in semantic analysis, not free-form names. You will choose and inspect one distinct source fragment for each.
Analyze the notebook and verify both symbols exist in the structured candidate index. Modified sources must be re-analyzed.
Only the first 24 indexed fragments per symbol are shown. This is not an exhaustive search.
Current file SHA matches analyzed snapshot. Interpretation remains unapproved.
This is your reversible entity-matching decision, not proof of real-world identity. Source Markdown is never edited. Later hints cite the journal event, not an inferred merge.
Withdrawal stops this alias from supporting new relationship hints. Prior journal events and source notes remain unchanged; historical conclusions must be reviewed separately.
Alias journal safety limit reached. No inferred matches are trusted until reviewed externally.
Enter two distinct symbols; reason must be at most 500 characters.
Nothing was intentionally changed. Check formal symbols, source availability, and current journal state. Re-analyze changed notes and start a fresh review.
Decision recorded in the private journal.

Record your assessment that two Markdown notes share an upstream source. Read both current excerpts first. This does not establish truth, source independence or entity identity; it never edits notes. Revocation adds a journal event.
Enter two different indexed note paths, relative to the selected notebook. Explain the shared upstream source. Only files with unchanged hashes can be approved.
Both Markdown files matched their indexed SHA-256 when this preview was created. These excerpts are for human source review; their claims remain unapproved.
Your annotation only links provenance of these two notes. It does not prove a common author, independence or truth. You can later withdraw it; original Markdown stays untouched.
Withdrawal references the exact original decision and leaves both historical journal events intact. It can be done even when the notebook is unavailable.
Enter two different relative Markdown paths and a reason of 1–500 characters.
No new decision was confirmed. Check the exact paths, notebook root, current file hashes, index and journal state; re-analyze changed notes.
Source decision recorded in the private journal.
Choose the other indexed file to review
These excerpts and hashes were saved at approval time and may no longer match the files on disk. Reopen the originals to verify current content.
Your descriptive classification of one original note, never a reliability or truth score. Review its current excerpt and hash before recording. Withdrawal preserves history.
Enter an indexed note path and your reason (1–500 characters). You will review the original excerpt before any journal operation.
This is your source-origin description, not evidence that its claims are true. The current file matched the indexed SHA-256 at preview; confirmation rechecks it.
Withdraw by the exact original journal decision ID, even offline. Do not change fact authority, inference or Markdown; prior events remain in history.
Enter an exact relative path and reason of 1–500 characters.
No decision was confirmed. Check paths, indexed original, notebook, current SHA-256 and journal head; re-analyze changed notes.
Source assessment saved to the private journal.

It uses fixed, generated numbers (similarity, token choice, reranking or simple classifier updates), with one warm-up and seven timed trials. No weights, tokenizer, notebook, journal, network or AI API are accessed. It may briefly use CPU and battery; tap Cancel benchmark to interrupt. Results CANNOT predict performance, RAM peak or quality of any real model.

Compare the resulting fingerprint with the offline Python reference for the SAME file; this test alone does not establish parity or model readiness. Manage cancels a pending task.
